\noindent\footnotesize Each cell compares raw generated-library \AC\ colour probes against \PAC\ staged-DAG JIT O1 and C++ O3 at the same final-state multiplicity \(n\).  Cell slots are \AC, \PAC\ JIT, and \PAC\ C++ O3; each slot shows generation time above runtime per phase-space point.  \PAC\ runtime multipliers are wall-time ratios relative to \AC, followed by a black pure-evaluator ratio when available.  Generation entries are in seconds; \AC\ runtime entries and absolute \PAC\ runtimes are in microseconds per point.  These NLC/full-colour tables use a single colour-complete contraction mode; the LC selected-flow versus all-flow split is not a separate concept at these colour accuracies. If no direct \AC\ reference exists, completed \PAC\ slots show absolute timings. For NLC/full-colour tables, \AC\ reference values come from the dedicated raw generated-library colour driver \texttt{amplicol\_color\_library\_probe}. Ratio colours are green below one, orange below two, and red otherwise.  The summary rows give \texttt{min|max|avg|med}; multiplier summaries add \texttt{sum}, the ratio of paired summed \PAC\ and \AC\ times.  For LC, separate generation and runtime summary rows match the one-flow helicity-summed and all-flow fixed-helicity slots.  Missing and structural N/A cells are ignored.  Validated rows use the same phase-space point and a \(10^{-8}\) relative tolerance.
\par\smallskip
\noindent\footnotesize A red \textbf{VALIDATION FAILED} marker is shown next to any validated entry whose relative difference exceeds \(10^{-8}\).
\par\smallskip
\paragraph{Matrix run settings.}
\noindent\footnotesize Generated by \path{docs/result_matrix.py} with \texttt{--color-accuracy nlc}, from \path{result_matrix_nlc_data.json} into \path{result_matrix_nlc_table.tex}. \AC\ uses the raw generated-library path \texttt{amplicol\_generate --library=create-raw} followed by \texttt{amplicol\_color\_library\_probe}, preserving NLC/full colour-order interferences. \PAC\ uses Rusticol double precision, batch size 64, output chunk size 128, stage-local evaluator inputs, ten Horner iterations, Symbolica's default CPE iteration choice, and enlarged Horner/common-pair limits.  JIT rows use SymJIT \(\mathrm{O}1\); timing runs use \texttt{--target-runtime 10}.  Only C++ O3 generation is subject to the 15-minute compile cap.
\par\smallskip
\paragraph{Fortran colour-reference limitations.}
\PAC\ generated these cells, but the current Fortran colour-reference path stops above two quark lines: $d\bar d\to u\bar{u}\,s\bar{s}+(n-4)g$, \(n=4\).
\par\smallskip
\paragraph{C++ O3 compile-budget gaps.}
These cells have completed \AC\ and \PAC\ JIT rows but no completed C++ O3 row: $d\bar d\to Z+(n-1)g$, \(n=1\): not run; $d\bar d\to Z+(n-1)g$, \(n=2\): not run; $d\bar d\to Z+(n-1)g$, \(n=3\): not run; $d\bar d\to Z+(n-1)g$, \(n=4\): not run; $u\bar d\to W^++(n-1)g$, \(n=1\): not run; $u\bar d\to W^++(n-1)g$, \(n=2\): not run; $u\bar d\to W^++(n-1)g$, \(n=3\): not run; $u\bar d\to W^++(n-1)g$, \(n=4\): not run; plus 23 more localized entries.
\par\smallskip
